title: Warp Scrolls
description: Use scrolls to teleport yourself to the surface or teleport yourself away from threats.
body:
# Introducing Warp Scrolls!
Pickaxe broken and you're deep underground? Hiding from some hostile mobs with nowhere else to run? Warp Scrolls has you covered.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/ffCsdu8eb4E" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

### What do warp scrolls do?
- If you are underground, the scroll will teleport you safely to the surface
- If you are on the surface, the scroll will safely teleport you to a random location
### Why should I use warp scrolls?
Ultimately, it saves you time - no more breaking or building your way back up to your base after a mining adventure, simply use your warp scroll and teleport yourself aboveground within seconds. It behaves similarly to the [Escape Rope](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Escape_Rope) from Pokémon games.

Maybe you made it to the end dimension with zero blocks, ender pearls or rockets - warp scrolls can help you skip across nearby end islands and return to safety.

Plus, it's fun to pretend you're an enderman every once in a while!

### WARNING
Be mindful of where you use the warp scroll! If you are too close to the Nether ceiling, you may end up stranded.
